## 2. Service Catalog & Common Technical Diagnoses

### Service 1: Air Conditioner (AC) Repair & Maintenance
- URL: https://applianceseva.com/ac-repair
- Bengali URL: https://applianceseva.com/bn/ac-repair
- Diagnosed Faults:
  - Not Cooling / Weak Airflow: Often caused by clogged evaporator coils, dirty air filters, faulty blower fan, or refrigerant shortage.
  - Gas Leakage & Low Refrigerant: Comprehensive nitrogen pressure leak test, brazing/soldering of copper pipes, vacuum purging, and gas refill using R32, R410A, or R22.
  - Indoor Unit Water Dripping: Blocked condensate drain tray or bent drain pipe cleared via high-pressure jet pump.
  - Frequent Compressor Tripping: Faulty starting capacitor, condenser fan motor overheating, or electrical PCB relay malfunction.
  - Inverter AC Error Codes: Component-level circuit repair for inverter PCB boards (outdoor and indoor).
  - Deep Jet Cleaning: Complete waterproof jacket jet servicing with anti-bacterial coil wash.

### Service 2: Refrigerator Repair
- URL: https://applianceseva.com/fridge-repair
- Bengali URL: https://applianceseva.com/bn/fridge-repair
- Diagnosed Faults:
  - Freezer Working but Fresh Food Section Warm: Defrost timer failure, faulty bi-metal thermostat, broken defrost heater, or blocked air damper duct.
  - No Cooling / Continuous Running: Gas leakage in capillary tube or evaporator, relay overload protector (OLP) failure, compressor mechanical seizure.
  - Excessive Frost Build-up: Damaged magnetic door gasket seal or defective auto-defrost circuit.
  - Loud Humming Noise: Condenser fan obstruction or worn-out compressor mounting rubber bushes.

### Service 3: Washing Machine Repair
- URL: https://applianceseva.com/washing-machine-repair
- Bengali URL: https://applianceseva.com/bn/washing-machine-repair
- Diagnosed Faults:
  - Drum Not Spinning: Worn motor belt, carbon brush wear, motor capacitor failure, or spider arm breakage.
  - Water Not Draining: Jammed drain filter, defective drain pump motor, or coin/debris blockage.
  - Severe Vibration & Banging Noise: Worn suspension shock absorbers, unbalanced load detector, or drum bearing failure.
  - Water Continuously Filling: Faulty water level pressure sensor (switch) or defective dual inlet solenoid valve.

### Service 4: Microwave Oven Repair
- URL: https://applianceseva.com/microwave-repair
- Bengali URL: https://applianceseva.com/bn/microwave-repair
- Diagnosed Faults:
  - Runs but Does Not Heat: Burnt-out high-voltage magnetron, defective high-voltage diode, shorted capacitor, or blown ceramic thermal fuse.
  - Sparking Inside Cavity: Carbon-burned mica waveguide cover sheet or peeling internal enamel paint.
  - Turntable Not Rotating: Defective low-RPM turntable synchronous motor or broken roller ring guide.
  - Touchpad Unresponsive: Membrane keypad ribbon cable oxidation or control PCB failure.

### Service 5: LED / Smart TV Repair
- URL: https://applianceseva.com/tv-repair
- Bengali URL: https://applianceseva.com/bn/tv-repair
- Diagnosed Faults:
  - Sound OK but No Picture / Black Screen: Blown LED backlight strips or defective LED backlight driver circuit.
  - Horizontal / Vertical Colored Lines on Display: T-Con board timing controller fault, COF ribbon IC bonding issue, or panel driver malfunction.
  - TV Keeps Restarting / Stuck on Logo: Corrupt eMMC flash memory, firmware crash, or standby power supply fluctuation.
  - HDMI / Audio Port Failure: Main logic motherboard repair.
